We are currently seeking a Senior Director, People & Culture to join our team. This role is not just about implementing strategies; it is about shaping the future of our organization. We are looking for a strategic and influential leader who can enhance our employee experience, foster an inclusive and high-performing culture, and drive impactful people strategies that enable business growth across Nigeria and Egypt. If you are excited about making a meaningful impact and transforming the way we work, we would love to hear from you. What You'll Do For Us Serve as the strategic People & Culture partner for business leaders and teams across Nigeria and Egypt, driving business performance through talent, culture, capability, and organization effectiveness strategies. Partner with senior stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and develop innovative people solutions aligned with organizational priorities. Lead and influence change management initiatives, ensuring successful adoption while taking into account employee experience, local cultural nuances, and organizational complexity. Coach and advise senior leaders on talent, culture, organizational effectiveness, leadership development, team performance, and employee engagement. Collaborate closely with the Global Culture & Engagement team, leadership teams, and People & Culture communities to implement listening strategies and translate insights into meaningful actions. Partner with the PACS team, Talent & Development team, Bottling Partners, and other key stakeholders to create and sustain an engaging employee experience and communication strategy. Lead organizational design, workforce planning, and capability-building initiatives that support business transformation and long-term growth. Drive robust succession planning and leadership pipeline development to ensure a strong and diverse talent bench. Foster a winning mindset and high-performance culture through strategic talent management, employee engagement, and inclusion initiatives. Ensure compliance with local employment legislation, labor relations requirements, and company policies across both markets. Stay connected to external trends and leading practices, continuously evolving organizational approaches to culture, engagement, talent, and communications. Strong expertise in HR business partnering, executive coaching, organizational effectiveness, talent management, and change leadership. Demonstrated success leading transformation, culture, engagement, and capability-building initiatives. Experience in talent acquisition, employee and labor relations, communications, and performance management. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. Bring curiosity, initiative, and a continuous‑improvement mindset to the team’s work. Experience with collaboration tools and data analytics reporting and measurement. Experience with integrated communications strategy within complex organizations. Excellent project management, collaboration, presentation, and writing skills.
